_comment: Single source of truth for crypto risk limits. Change only via the weekly review (crypto-trading/references/self-update.md). fee_bps must match your real tier (check with fetch_trading_fee / the exchange fee page); it drives every backtest and sizing decision.

graduation.rule: Live only with: walk-forward verdict pass on real data, >= min_days of paper with no rule violations, drawdown within halt, written go/no-go in lessons.md, trade-only API keys (withdrawals disabled, IP allow-listed), and ALLOW_LIVE_TRADING=yes.

_fees: Kraken Pro entry tier verified 2026-10-05: spot taker 0.80%, maker 0.40%; stablecoin/FX pairs 0.20%/0.20%. Lower tiers need volume. Re-check monthly; fee_bps drives every backtest.
